info.title: Azure Monitor Observability Agent Identity Access
info.description: Advisory identity role inspection for Azure Monitor observability agents.

get.description: List the operations for the provider

post.description:
Inspects whether a user-assigned managed identity has the Monitoring Contributor role
at each target subscription or an applicable inherited scope, using the caller's delegated
authorization. Use this route before the agent's resource group exists; the caller needs
Microsoft.Monitor/observabilityAgents/read at the subscription or an ancestor.
The location selects regional routing and is not a role-assignment target.
Returns HTTP 200 for present, missing, and unverifiable role outcomes. This advisory action
neither creates an agent nor enforces creation, and does not evaluate effective permissions.

Inspects whether a user-assigned managed identity has the Monitoring Contributor role
at each target subscription or an applicable inherited scope, using the caller's delegated
authorization. Use this route when the agent's resource group already exists; the caller
needs Microsoft.Monitor/observabilityAgents/read at that resource group or an ancestor.
The location selects regional routing and is not a role-assignment target.
Returns HTTP 200 for present, missing, and unverifiable role outcomes. This advisory action
neither creates an agent nor enforces creation, and does not evaluate effective permissions.

ObservabilityAgentIdentityAccessContent.description:
Inputs for advisory inspection of the Monitoring Contributor role at subscription scope.
No observability agent is created or modified, and no role assignments are changed.

userAssignedIdentityResourceId.description:
Resource ID of the existing user-assigned managed identity to inspect.
The ID must reference Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities in a subscription.
Its hosting subscription is not automatically included among the target subscriptions.

monitoringAccountId.description:
Resource ID of an Azure Monitor account whose subscription is also checked.
Omission or null adds no subscription. An empty string is invalid.

monitoredResourceIds.description:
Resource IDs whose subscriptions are also checked, deduplicated with the route and
monitoring account subscriptions. Omission, null, or an empty array adds no subscriptions.
Each item must be a nonempty subscription-scoped ARM resource ID; null items are invalid.

ObservabilityAgentIdentityAccessError.description:
An error from the resource provider or ARM gateway. Invalid input returns HTTP 400
with top-level code and message and no error envelope. ARM gateway failures use
the common ARM error object and omit the top-level code and message.
The properties are optional in this shared schema because neither shape contains
the other's fields; this does not change either component's error format.

code.description: Present with message for invalid preflight input; the code is InvalidIdentityPreflightRequest.

message.description: Present with code for invalid preflight input; describes the invalid input.

ObservabilityAgentIdentityAccessReason.description: Reason the recommended role could not be verified.

values.name: IdentityLookupFailed
values.description: The identity could not be retrieved using the caller's authorization.

values.name: TargetTenantUnavailable
values.description: The target subscription's tenant could not be determined.

values.name: IdentityTenantMismatch
values.description: The identity and target subscription belong to different tenants.

values.name: RoleAssignmentsReadDenied
values.description: The caller could not read the relevant role assignments.

values.name: InvalidArmResponse
values.description: A dependency returned an invalid or incomplete response.

values.name: ConditionalRoleAssignment
values.description: Only conditional matching assignments were found; their conditions were not evaluated.

values.name: IncompleteRoleAssignmentListing
values.description: The role assignment listing exceeded the inspection's pagination limit.

ObservabilityAgentIdentityAccessResource.description:
A subscription-scoped ARM resource ID with a valid subscription GUID and a nonempty resource name.
The value must start with a slash and must not contain double slashes, backslashes, query
strings, fragments, or dot path segments. A trailing slash is accepted and removed.

ObservabilityAgentIdentityAccessResult.description:
Advisory role inspection result. Presence of Monitoring Contributor is not a guarantee
that every future operation will succeed; absence does not exclude sufficient permissions
through other roles. The result does not enforce observability agent creation.

status.description:
Overall outcome. UnableToVerify takes precedence over RecommendedRoleMissing,
which takes precedence over RecommendedRolePresent.

userAssignedIdentityResourceId.description: The inspected user-assigned managed identity resource ID, with a trailing slash removed.

recommendedRole.description: The recommended role display name: Monitoring Contributor.

recommendedRoleDefinitionId.description: The Monitoring Contributor role definition GUID: 749f88d5-cbae-40b8-bcfc-e573ddc772fa.

subscriptions.description:
One result per distinct target subscription, sorted by subscription ID.
The route subscription is always included. Account and monitored resource subscriptions
are added when supplied. Assignments must apply to the subscription, including applicable
inherited root or management-group assignments and group membership returned by ARM.
Resource-group-only and resource-only assignments do not satisfy this check.

ObservabilityAgentIdentityAccessStatus.description: Outcome of an advisory check for the recommended role, not an effective-permissions evaluation.

values.name: RecommendedRolePresent
values.description: An unconditional applicable Monitoring Contributor assignment was found.

values.name: RecommendedRoleMissing
values.description: No applicable Monitoring Contributor assignment was found in the completed inspection.

values.name: UnableToVerify
values.description: The inspection could not conclusively determine whether the recommended role is present.

ObservabilityAgentIdentitySubscriptionAc.description: The advisory role inspection result for a target subscription.

subscriptionId.description: The target subscription ID, formatted as a GUID.

status.description: Whether an applicable recommended role assignment was found for this subscription.

reasonCode.description: Present when the status is UnableToVerify; otherwise omitted.
